review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion support for Lob QR scan analytics and billing group metadata, and improves warehouse ingestion robustness against pagination changes.
review.reason: The chunk removes Lob QR analytics ingestion, adds metadata definitions for billing groups and QR analytics, and updates pagination handling. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it enables PostHog warehouse to collect QR scan events and billing group labels, and makes warehouse ingestion more robust against pagination failures.
